answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each agent identity must emit a signed heartbeat every interval; missed beats raise a plume of decay recorded in the ledger. New identities start at zero reputation and accrue it only through consecutive beats, so a delta between fresh and aged identities stays wide. An attacker must run every sybil through real time and compute to close that gap, paying cloud cost and idle cycles per fake identity. A single ember of lapsed attention resets the streak.
